blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Commission on Audit (COA) has “affirmed with finality” the notice of disallowance it issued on the P73 million confidential funds of the Office of the Vice President (OVP). In a resolution dated Oct. 5, the COA said it denied the OVP’s motion for reconsideration filed against COA’s Notice of Disallowance (ND) on Aug. 8, 2024. The matter pertains to the OVP’s confidential expenses for the period from December 21 to 31, 2022, worth P73.287 million. “The Motion for Reconsideration of Vice President Sara Z.
